description: Wraps a ScrollView to enable programmatic scrolling to specific element IDs.

content.description: Single child view — typically a ScrollView

scrollTo.description: Element ID to scroll to: when the reader appears, and again after every write to the reader (setElementProperty, setElementValue, setElementState; the same ID scrolls again)

anchor.description: Alignment anchor for the scrolled-to item; default 'center'
